notes.title: [Notice] Server Merge & Account Migration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44247380/ab6f1a02d7b79d9ce36521f98c17cbea81920c19.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Guardians!

We are pleased to announce an upcoming server merge aimed at enhancing community engagement and player interactions. On [u][b]February 18, 2025,[/b][/u] we will merge [C9 Golden] into the [C9 Global] Asia server, creating a more vibrant and thriving game world.

[b][Merge Details:][/b]

[b]Merge Date & Time: [/b] [u]February 18, 2025, 10:00 - 17:00[/u] (Server Time)
[b]Post-Merge Server: [/b] [i]Your character data will be transferred to the [C9 Global] Asia server.[/i]

[b]Required Actions for Steam Users:[/b]
To continue playing after the merge, please update your client and complete the account data transfer as follows:

[olist]
[*]Access the game via Steam.
[*]Confirm the merge announcement and register your VFUN account.
[*]Enter your VFUN account and password, then click “Apply for Character Transfer.”
[*]The client will automatically update to the [C9 Global] version.
[/olist]

After the character transfer, please use the VFUN client to log in, as the Steam client will no longer be supported.

[b]Merging Rules and Data Adjustments:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Characters
[list]
[*] All characters under your account will be retained.
[*] Deleted characters can be restored within 72 hours from the character selection screen.
[/list]

[*] Character Names
[list]
[*] If a character name is duplicated on the merged server, you will be prompted to change your character’s name before logging in. You may select any available name that meets the naming rules.
[/list]

[*] Data Changes
[list]
[*] Stamina will be reset.
[*] Character appearance change coupons will be available for all characters post-merge.
[*] Check-in rewards, leaderboards, and friend data will be reset.
[*] Leaderboards data will be reset.
[*] Friend List data will be reset.
[/list]

[*] Blocked Accounts
[list]
[*] Accounts that are currently blocked will remain inaccessible after the merge.
[/list]

[*] Duplicate Guild Names
[list]
[*] After the merge, if there are multiple guilds with the same name on the server, the guild name will be forced to be changed. When the guild leader logs in to the game, he/she will be required to change the guild name, and the rules are the same as those for duplicate character names.
[/list]

[*] Remaining G coins
[list]
[*] Remaining GS will be converted according to the GS-NCC exchange ratio and then issued the current NCC equivalent value of the event G-coins. (Event G-coins are valid for 30 days)
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]Merging Rewards:[/b]

To show our appreciation, the following rewards will be provided after the merge:
[list]
[*] Joker II ×1
[*] Inventory Expansion Scroll ×2
[*] Palladium Broadway Straight Chest-R3 ×6
[*] Sphinx [Ace] ×1
[*] Akene Coins [10,000] ×1
[*] Spring Koi Skill Book Optional Chest [30 days] ×10
[*] Startreak Medal Chest [9000] ×1
[*] Super Training [8 times][1 hr] ×5
[/list]

[b]Items Removed After the Merge:[/b]

The following items will be deleted:
[list]
[*] God's Stone
[*] God's Stone Bait
[*] NCC Exchange Stone 
[*] Low God's Stone Potion
[*] Middle God's Stone Potion
[*] Advanced God's Stone Potion
[*] Pet Star Guardian Spirit Box
[*] Pet Star Guardian Box
[*] Misty Season trove Key
[*] Low God's Stone Potion
[*] Middle God's Stone Potion
[*] Advanced God's Stone Potion
[*] God's Stone Bait
[*] Daily Rewards Chest
[*] Weekly Rewards Chest
[*] Level Rewards Chest
[*] Novice Fishing Rod Optional Chest
[*] Other GS-related items
[/list]

Thank you for your understanding and support as we continue working to enhance the C9 experience. We’re looking forward to this exciting new chapter and the opportunities it will bring to our player community.

[i][b]C9 Operations Team[/b][/i]
